note: Barbados: CARICOM nationals of Belize, Dominica and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines move freely; nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 6 months, 90 days (90 in 180 for the EU but Ireland), 30 or 28. Nationals of Afghanistan, Haiti, Iran, Taiwan and the others on the visa list need one from a mission, which with the two lists covers every state (a territory's passport meets its state's rule). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade's own table of visa requirements (revised 9 May 2025), its column for foreign nationals entering Barbados and its remarks: it corrected Wikipedia's copy, read before, on Belize (6 months, not without limit), Botswana (60 days), Switzerland, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway (90 days in any 180, not 6 months), Nigeria and Uruguay (6 months, not 90 days) and Croatia (28 days, its own row). It gives no length for about eighty of the visa-free nationalities (most by the waiver agreements of 28 July 2022) and leaves the Maldives' and Timor-Leste's rows blank: those stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.said: Most visitors to Barbados may enter without a visa. However, citizens of certain countries must obtain a visa from one of the Barbadian diplomatic missions . ... AUSTRIA ... No visa required Short-stay visa waiver signed between Barbados and the European Community on May 28, 2009. Nationals of both countries may visit the other country for a stay of up to three (3) months in any six month period. ... BOTSWANA ... No visa required COMMONWEALTH Country Nationals of Botswana can stay for a maximum of sixty (60) days without a visa ... CROATIA ...
